sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 打扰一下。

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 什么？

fragments.text: I wonder if you could spare a few minutes to do a
on transport. It won't take long.

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 我在想你能不能腾出几分钟帮我做一下关于交通的调查，不会耽误太久。

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 当然没问题。

fragments.text: the local council. They'd like to know about what

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 太棒了。这份调查代表当地的市委会。他们想知道你使用什么交通方式以及你对改善交通的建议。

fragments.text: Can I start by asking you how you travelled to town today?

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 我可以从问你今天你怎样到镇上来的开始这个调查吗？

fragments.text: Sure. I came on the bus.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 当然可以。我坐公交车来的。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 好的。现在我可以问你一些关于你自己的细节吗？

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 好的。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 你叫什么？

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 是路易莎……

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 好的。

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 哈迪。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 能拼一下吗？

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 是H-A-R-D-I-E。

fragments.text: Great. Thanks. And can I have your

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 好的，谢谢。我可以问下你的地址吗？

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 是白石头路19号。

fragments.text: Oh, right. I know that area. It's Bradfield, isn't it?

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 哦好的。我知道那个地区。是布拉德菲尔德，是不是？

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 是的。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 邮编是GT7吗？

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 实际上是GT8 2LC。

fragments.text: Great. And could I ask what your job is? Are you a student?

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 好的。我能问下你的工作吗？你是学生吗？

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 实际上我刚完成我的培训。我是个美发师。

fragments.text: Oh, right. And one more question in this section. What is

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 哦好的。这部分最后一个问题：你今天来镇上的目的是什么？

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 实际上今天不是来购物的，这通常是我来的原因。但是今天是来看牙医的。

fragments.text: Right. Thanks. Now in this last section I'd like you to give us
in the city for getting to and from work, any

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 好的，谢谢。现在在最后这个部分，我想让你对于城市中上下班的设施和安排给出些想法，以及任何改进建议。

fragments.text: Well, something I've thought about for some time is that when I do walk and I'm doing a
I think the lighting should be better.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 那么，有个事我已经考虑了一阵子了，是当我上晚班，走路的时候，我觉得灯光可以再好些。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 好的，点子不错。

fragments.text: And of course, I think it's a
. They should have more of those. Then people would walk more.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 当然，我想他们减少人行小路的数量真的很遗憾。他们应该多设些。这样走路的人就更多了。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 好的。

fragments.text: And, I don't think there are enough trains. That's why I don't use them - you have to wait so long.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 而且，我认为火车也不够。这就是我不坐它们的原因，你必须要等很久。

fragments.text: Thanks. And finally I'd like to ask your
. As you may know, there's a
in the city to get more people to

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 谢谢。最后我想问问你关于骑自行车的想法。你可能知道，现在城里有种趋势，有越来越多的人骑车上班。

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 是的。

fragments.text: that there are things which the council, but also employers, might do to help

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 但是我们意识到市委会，还有雇主可能可以做些事鼓励员工骑车上班。

fragments.text: Yep. Well, I have thought about it and where I work there are no

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 是的。我想过这件事，在我工作的地方，没有一个安全的存放自行车的地方。

fragments.text: And also, I'd have to cycle uphill and on a hot day I'd arrive at work
so I think I'd need a

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 而且，在热天我一路骑车上山，到单位的时候已经浑身是汗了，所以我觉得我需要在工作的地方有个可以冲凉的地方。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 好的。

fragments.text: And I suppose the last thing is that I wouldn't be all that
about cycling on such busy roads. I think I'd like to see you
for that, you know, I'd feel a lot better about starting if that was the case.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 还有我猜最后一点是我对在如此繁忙的路上骑车不是很自信。我希望你们可以提供相关的培训，你知道的，如果能这样的话，开始骑车我会感觉更好些。

fragments.text: Well, that's very helpful. Thank you very much for your time.

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.translation: 好的，这真的很有帮助。非常感谢你的时间。

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 不客气，再见！
